Cold is first actor read. TCP counters report actual aggregate PostgreSQL protocol bytes, with the per-request mean explicitly separated from decoded per-request maxima. SQL plans and pure policy compilation are separate post-load probes to avoid timing interference. Browser measured separately. No serving database writes.
